steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We're here, Old Tung.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Same as always?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yup. Two mala, one curry, and a clear soup.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Man, Old Tung's finballs are really—

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Old Tung? That's Uncle Tung to you, boy!

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: It just slipped out, man.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I know we call you Dumb Tau sometimes, but do you really have to be stupid for real?

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: What's with you today, Ah Sam?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I just can't with this dumbass—

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: So what if he's dumb? What did Madame Oni tell you, huh? Who you trying to act all big for?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Ah Hsiang! I don't care if I'm an idiot or not, just stop arguing.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Right, Madame Oni? Say a little something.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Come on, guys. You're all hangry, or what?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Sam, apologize to Daai Tau.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Sorry... I got worked up.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Hsiang, say sorry to Ah Sam too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Hsiang!

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: My bad. Shouldn't have been so aggro.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Now we're all good, yeah?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Let's switch topics. What happened to the guys under 'Kyut Yat Mun' after you got rid of him two days back?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mr. Lin has his own plans, so I didn't ask. But seems like he just told them to behave, so they got off pretty lightly.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Uh, Madame Oni.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm? What is it?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Actually, I wanted to ask...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I see Dumb Tou's mouth is slow today too. I'll do it. Madame Oni, isn't today our... uh...

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Come on, guys. One after the other?

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: I'll say it for them, Madame Oni. You told us your plans for the future, so we were thinking, why not throw one last party?

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Cause we might not get the chance to meet up again in future, so we wanted to ask... why exactly do you want to...

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Go to the—

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Make way, make way. Finballs incoming.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: My thank you present for ridding Downtown of those pests: radish for each of you, and Hoshiguma gets an extra fowlbeast wing.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Ah Hsiang & Ah Sam & Daai Tau
Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sigh. I know you guys have your worries, but what happened to the smooth talkers I know, the ones who say they taught me how to talk? Why so quiet now?

steps.name: Ah Hsiang & Ah Sam & Daai Tau
steps.text: ...Thanks, Uncle Tung.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: It's normal for kids to be in denial after you drop such a big bomb on them.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I have to handle the takeaway orders. Sauces are all self-service over at the counter.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: 'Big bomb'? Didn't Madame Oni just tell us about it today? How does he know already?

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Dude, your years in with the triads were a waste.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: You know why Uncle Tung has a lame leg? You know who he took a blow for?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Who? Mr. Lin?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: You really don't get it, huh? If Mr. Lin were the one I couldn't talk about, why would it be safe for you to constantly bring him up? Think about it: who is it that really shouldn't be mentioned?

spans.text: You really don't get it, huh? If Mr. Lin were the one I couldn't talk about, why would it be safe for you to constantly bring him up? Think about it: who is it that

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Uh... Wei—?!

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: At least you knew to stop at his family name. Want a medal?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: My bad, man. Me and my dumb ass.

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Uncle Tung and Mr. Lin are good old buddies because they both worked for that guy, back in the day.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Now I see. I was just wondering why Mr. Lin was giving Madame Oni so much scary work lately. First it was 'Fowlwing Ng', then 'Funerary Cin', and now 'Kyut Yat Mun' today...
The dinner table turns quiet again.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Daai Tau, you and your big mouth!

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Forget it, man.

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Madame Oni, didn't you say the Higashinese love to eat from every stall at your festivals or something? We're practically done with our finballs, so why don't we go for round two?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sure. Can't split up this early, can we?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Alcohol is where the real fun begins!

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Yeah, man—

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Stop. Not another word from you tonight, or you'll spoil the mood.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Dumb Tau is such a handful. Madame Oni, I have a feeling he still thinks you're a Forte.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Hey, now the garbage's coming out of YOUR mouth. I know she's an Oni from Higashi, okay?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Shame on you!

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: It's not like Madame Oni's fresh off the boat in Lungmen, dude. She was with the Leungyi Society before she enlightened our useless asses, you know.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: The Leungyi Society?! Those are some tough customers!

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: What do you think, huh? Well, she was an unusually upstanding lady back in the day, so she had a big fanclub. And that's when Mr. Lin noticed her too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Enough war stories. I was a little too conspicuous those days, which is why the Leungyi Society...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: But how could they blame you? Didn't Mr. Lin ask for your help? Could he have found someone else to do your job?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Isn't it thanks to you that half the society got out alive? And did anyone in the triads ever sully your name over this?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I just can't help but to be mad for your sake.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Mr. Lin hired her once, to teach the Leungyi Society and Bagua Gang a lesson. I won't even get into him establishing the rules, but Lungmen hasn't seen a major gang in power since.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: These past few years, the remnants have been showing up on the streets, so Mr. Lin called her in to help again.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: But in the end... heh...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Forget it. Enough talk! Drink!

steps.name: Barkeep's Voice
steps.text: Huh? What are you doing?

steps.name: Barkeep's Voice
steps.text: Madame Oni! Someone's—

steps.name: Barkeep's Voice
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Fierce Voice
steps.text: Calling the cops? Lee Bo-faat, you must be eager to die.
Hoshiguma suddenly stands up.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Faat?!

steps.name: Unremarkable Barkeep
steps.text: *cough* I'm fine, Madame Oni. He won't pull anything drastic with you around.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mind dropping us a name, so we can catch up later?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: No need to know where I'm from. I'm just here for one thing: to congratulate you on making your big deal.
The man slams the beer bottle on the table, and the jagged glass shines with a dangerous gleam.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: With just a broken beer bottle?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: A broken bottle? You're underestimating what's inside.
The man reaches inside the bottle to pull out a rolled-up letter with his bleeding hand.

steps.name: Flustered Tourist
steps.text: H-Hurry and call the cops!

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: The cops?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Your accent tells me you're no local.

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: I don't blame you for not knowing. Go and call then. How long do you think the cops will take to show?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Wanna guess who they'll vent their anger on when you call them out here for nothing?

steps.name: Flustered Tourist
steps.text: How... how could this be...

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Check a guidebook before your next vacation, and avoid the slums, you hear me?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Now scram!
The tourist rushes out of the bar.
The fierce man turns back to Hoshiguma and her group.

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Let's get back on topic. 'Madame Oni', from today onwards, you are public enemy number one of all Lungmen's triads.

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: She only got rid of the real bullies, the ones who were even against you, and you want to make an enemy of her? You should be grateful!

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: You think we don't know who she was working for?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Today, Lin tells her to kill 'Kyut Yat Mun', and she does it. If he puts one of my boys on the chopping block tomorrow, what do we do then, huh?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: To all you who don't live our lives, witness this with your eyes; and those who do, remember this—

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: She is now and will always be a traitor to our Downtown Lungmen.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: What the hell are you saying? Who did she betray, huh?!

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Didn't she take the Lungmen Guard Department's offer to become a cop?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Did this Oni not murder our brothers without hesitation, and even take the heads of a bunch of big shot triads just to show the cops her loyalty?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: All lies and slander—

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Slander? Why isn't she denying it, then?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: I noticed your group's gloomy vibe the second I walked in here. You there don't get how your wonderful Madame Oni could become a cop?

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: If you wanna run with the triads, then you better cut her loose as soon as you can. It's true, we can't beat her right now, but do you think she can keep you safe around the clock?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: You don't have to drive a wedge between us—

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Laai Gam Sam, how's your mother doing?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: You dare?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There's no need to hassle these young men.

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Stepping up on your own, huh? How kind you are, 'Madame'. Is that why Lin likes you so much, a blade that's loyal to a fault?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This is between us. Keep Mr. Lin out of it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Listen up, fellas. Anyone who dares raise a hand against my people, or even their friends and family without good reason...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You can look forward to me knocking down your door with Hannya and hacking you to bits and pieces.

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Fierce Man
steps.text: Whatever. I'm just a messenger, and my job's done. See ya!

steps.name: Unremarkable Barkeep
steps.text: Madame Oni, don't listen to that rotter. Want something to drink?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Faat...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I won't bother you anymore. Get me the bill, and we'll go somewhere else for drinks.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Damn. There's no other hole in Downtown that'll take us...

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Forget it, man. We already got some beer from the convenience store and no one's gonna bother us, so it doesn't matter where we crack these cans open. Let's find somewhere with a cool breeze—

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: A breeze? The L.G.D. rooftop's probably the best spot for that.

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Again with the garbage, huh?!

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: I can't hold it in.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: What's wrong with Mr. Lin, letting Madame Oni work with the L.G.D.?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: That jerk with the bottle can go to hell, but... I just can't figure it out.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: I just can't! What about you two, huh? And you, Madame Oni?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Yeah, I'm Dumb Tau, so tell me, you smart ones, what exactly are Lin and Wei planning with this?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Didn't I tell you from the start? It was my own decision to accept Mr. Wei's offer—

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Yes, and you were right to! I'm not being sarcastic either, I know that was an offer you couldn't refuse!

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: After what happened earlier, even I know now you're a thorn in the side of the triads, and they'll do whatever it takes to get rid of you.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: And yet, what's Lin doing? He oughta be standing up for you! And what did he do? He made you become a cop!

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: How are you gonna survive in Lungmen if you turn him down? You could only take the deal!

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Madame Oni, did you forget how the cops treat us?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: They don't even think of us as human. All they ever do is kick us around.

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: To be honest, Madame Oni. I don't get it either. What can a triad do, joining the L.G.D.?

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: The way I see it, Mr. Lin's just trying to curry favor with the other triads by getting you in there. Letting their guard down as they laugh at you, while he slowly takes control—
Before Ah Hsiang gets to finish, Ah Sam abruptly stands up.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What are you doing, Ah Sam?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Nothing. I'm going to the L.G.D.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This late? They're already closed.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Who cares? If the doors are locked, I'll just climb up, all the way to the roof.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Those damned cops are always trampling on us, so tonight we're flipping the tables on them.
The three young men stride towards the L.G.D headquarters with drink in tow.
Hoshiguma could have stopped them, but she is one step too slow.
Or perhaps, she just doesn't want to tamp down the determination of the lackeys who care for her.
They do not fear her leaving, they fear the police will mistreat her.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Hah... hah... did... we finally make it?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Entering from the top-floor warehouse's the only option, seeing as the way to the roof was blocked by a bunch of stuff.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: I didn't think the L.G.D.'s roof would be stuffed with so much junk...

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: Madame Oni... you sure you wanna go with us? Your new job's starting soon, what if your boss finds out you were here...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's there to be afraid of? Even if the sky falls, I'm tall and I've got a horn. I'll just put a hole in it.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Haha! Hahaha...

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: I'm real worried, Madame Oni. You being you, it'll only take a year or two before they start bullying and manipulating you.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Not happening with her. If it does, just come find us.
Ah Sam chugs his beer.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: We'll try our best to hold on while she's away. I don't think Madame Oni will tolerate those bastards forever.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: ...Madame Oni?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It wasn't Mr. Lin who had me join the L.G.D., but Mr. Wei. Why would he ever need to help Mr. Lin?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Didn't you say Uncle Tung and Mr. Lin used to work for Wei? If something happened to me, you'd help me out, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, now!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wanna look at this?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Isn't this the scrap that guy pulled out of his bottle? What about it?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Look at the signatures.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Tung Zeng, Anchors, Lian Heng, Si Yau, Baak Coek... and the Char Sius?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Who came up with these names? Did they get an earful from their mom while brainstorming to settle on 'Char Sius'?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The funny ones are all baby gangs. With Mr. Lin breathing down their necks, no one dares use a cool name like 'Leungyi' or 'Bagua' anymore.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why do you think they tried to intimidate us today? You think they'd bother staging their broken bottle act if they actually had the guts to step over Mr. Lin and rub us out?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Lungmen will get better. I want to believe.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's changed a lot compared to when I first arrived here, and I think it'll only get better in future.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Madame Oni, if that's true, then why not just lay low until Mr. Lin gets all the triads under control?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: There's no reason you have to be a cop. Unless you were one in Higashi? Guess that'd make sense then.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No... the things I did there... were far worse than what I've done in Lungmen.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: When all's said and done, those guys want you gone anyhow.
The warehouse atmosphere relaxed a little from laughing over the Char Sius' name, but the silence brings the mood back down.
Each man chugs a bottle on his own, their eyes turning redder and redder as the alcohol goes down.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Yeah, fine. Lungmen will get better and better, just not us.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Sam—

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Madame Oni, you've never told us about what happened back in Higashi, and we've never asked. So I'll just talk about our Lungmen days.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: You had it good with the Leungyi Society, but Lin destroyed it, and forced you to go solo!

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Then you ran into us, and gave us a hand. You helped us live like actual people...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: We want to treat you as one of us, like family. We want you to succeed, become famous—you have the moves for it!

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: But what're we looking at now? They're forcing you to hide, and turning you into a target for the cops... what right do they even have to do that?!

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Madame Oni, you said you want to believe Lungmen will get better. Do you really believe it, or are you just pushing yourself? I... I...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: You're gonna be a cop? Over my dead body!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Sam—
In two quick steps, Ah Sam slams open the locked door to the rooftop. The cold night breeze pours into the warehouse, rousing a moldy stench.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Sam!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You've had too much. Let's go down, and let's all go home.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Home? I can kowtow to my ah gong and go back home, but you? Madame Oni, do you really want to live the rest of your life as a puppet of the powerful?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Don't trust them! Yeah, they have the power, but they treat us like toys! They've never taken us seriously!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You ask if I really think Lungmen will get better. And yeah—I'm not sure it'll happen. But I have to believe in it. I have to.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The first time we met, should I have assumed you three were a trap laid by one of my enemies, or assassins out to kill me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm an Oni who destroyed my own home. I had no choice but to come here to Lungmen. At first, I didn't think I could fit in, I only wanted to be alone.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It was my Leungyi brothers who took me around the skyscrapers and busy streets to try char siu, lou seoi, and curry finballs.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I used to have trouble getting the Lungmen dialect tones right, and you guys were the ones who helped me practice.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And Mr. Lin? He's never stabbed me in the back.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So I have to trust him. Otherwise...
Ah Sam trembles. He knows what she isn't saying.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Wanna bet? You won't last more than half a year at the L.G.D. You'll leave and never want to come back again.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not taking your bet.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: You scared?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, I'm already playing.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I know, you're betting Lungmen will be kind to you.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: But I know how scary it is to lose this bet, and I'm scared of seeing you lose.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I'm scared of seeing the fearless Madame Oni who only just learned how we talk... get stabbed in the back and become miserable again.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Even if it costs my life, I won't let you play on their table!

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I just can't bear to see them bully you, Madame Oni.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Sam, let's not be rash—
Ah Sam walks backwards, again and again, until his heel hits air.
He is now truly at a loss.
And so, under the alcohol's influence, he makes up his mind and falls backwards—
His collar is firmly grabbed, and his face slapped.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you crazy?!
The feeling of weightlessness dispels most of his tipsiness.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Enough! Go downstairs, all of you! I'll personally see you three home tonight, safe and sound!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ID, notebook, passport photo, and forms... they're all here.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: Madame Oni—I mean, Officer Hoshiguma!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah Sam?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What are you doing here? Not trying to climb back up again, are you—

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: What are you talking about? I drank too much last night. And thinking back, it was my fault.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So what are you doing here?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: So you're the Hoshiguma who's been sent our way?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: And those guys behind you? Here to sign on too?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They—

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Sir, we're triads Officer Hoshiguma arrested on her way to work today!

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Officer Hoshiguma swept all three of us off our feet in one move. Three bad dudes on her first day, sounds pretty awesome, right...?

steps.name: Ah Hsiang
steps.text: (Whispering) Dumb Tau, no one's gonna believe that!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Pfft, just get outta here already.

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: We're real triads! We got plenty of cash on us too, you know. Arrest us and you can pick our pockets while you pad your records—

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Chief Wei only just put out these new law enforcement guidelines, and here you are trying to bribe me?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: Fine, you got us, so why not give me a good whack with your stick?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: My stick? What are you talking about? Oh, I know. You're baiting me. I hit you, you write a complaint to the L.G.D., and I lose my job. Right?

steps.name: Daai Tau
steps.text: What?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I see you're really itching for a beating though. Let's have Hoshiguma here take care of that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Just tell me 'these three bastards were harassing me', and I'll have grounds to toss them in the can for a few days of reflection. What do you think?
Ah Hsiang and Daai Tau run away.
Ah Sam also moves to go, but he turns back to look at Hoshiguma once more before he flees.
Hoshiguma returns his gaze.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That bet. Do you think I'll win or lose now?

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I don't know, but...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: I can at least dare to hope you win, Madame Oni.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Thanks for believing in me.

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: But... if, and I'm saying if...

steps.name: Ah Sam
steps.text: If you really do lose, don't forget us. We'll always be here, waiting, you get me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...I won't forget.
The L.G.D. entrance is minimally decorated, but the dazzling simplicity almost has Ah Sam's eyes watering.
He does not dare to look at this place any longer, and wipes his face quickly. He bows slightly in Hoshiguma's direction, and runs toward Downtown, back to his brothers.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: That was so weird. Were those thugs trying to cozy up to you?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I'm telling you, you don't have to save their faces, these useless dregs—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're my brothers.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: So you...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're my brothers. Always have been.
